author: JandJSecurity
body: The evidence u have shows nothing. It shows ljt swining at his teammate at killing some people. So is he banned for killing people or something or is there another reason. It makes no sense because we were screen sharing and I could see that he had no hacks. Also we were talking w skype and i could tell him if i saw people coming at him so he would know. He shouldn't be banned for doing nothing. He could have easily had a good ping and hit him
